prerequisites.quote: In order to receive any of the Financial Credits described above, Customer must [notify Google technical support](https://support.google.com/cloud/contact/cloud_platform_sla) within thirty days from the time Customer becomes eligible to receive a Financial Credit.

claim_window.quote: within thirty days from the time Customer becomes eligible to receive a Financial Credit

claim_procedure.quote: Customer must [notify Google technical support](https://support.google.com/cloud/contact/cloud_platform_sla) within thirty days from the time Customer becomes eligible to receive a Financial Credit. Customer must also provide Google with log files showing loss of response to name server queries from Google name servers on specific domain managed by Cloud DNS and the date and time they occurred.

remedy_form.quote: Financial Credits will be made in the form of a monetary credit applied to future use of the Covered Service and will be applied within 60 days after the Financial Credit was requested.
